item.title: Warriors GM Mike Dunleavy welcomes Porzingis, denies shopping Green, Butler before trade
item.description: Warriors introduce Kristaps Porzingis during pregame press conference in Los Angeles

item.title: Prep wrestling: Novato’s Carroll reigns again, San Marin takes MCAL titles
item.description: As she nears the end of a landmark career at Archie Williams High, Sofia De Jesus stood proudly on the mat among the first wrestlers to be crowned MCAL girls champions on Saturday. Meanwhile, Novato High’s Braeden Carroll firmly established himself as one of Marin County’s all-time greatest wrestlers with his fourth consecutive MCAL heavyweight championship.

item.title: Moses Moody’s big night not enough to push Warriors past LeBron’s Lakers
item.description: Moody scores 25 points while taking on a leading scoring role as Steph Curry sits with runner's knee.

item.title: San Rafael sea-level report evaluates options for Canal area
item.description: The study outlines three options — constructing seawalls, installing flood gates or raising the land — that could cost $720 million to nearly $2 billion.

item.title: MCE considers rate cut amid questions on energy contracts
item.description: The discussion comes as the company prepares its budget for the next fiscal year and faces pressure to lower bills.

item.title: San Rafael mall landmark nears demolition for housing
item.description: Workers are preparing the tear down the Sears building in Terra Linda to make way for a 1,422-residence development.

item.title: Larkspur makes mid-year budget adjustments
item.description: The revised budget increases overall expenditures by $458,000 and decreases revenues by $795,000.

item.title: Marin grad uses AI to improve data about northern lights
item.description: Jason Press, a former student at Marin Catholic High School, is part of a Pepperdine University team apply the technology to the aurora borealis.

item.title: Okorie scores career-high 40 points, leads Stanford over Georgia Tech 95-72 to end 5-game skid
item.description: Freshman star surpassed his previous high of 36 points scored in the Cardinal’s win against then-No. 14 North Carolina on Jan. 14.

item.title: No. 20 Clemson routs California 77-55, ties Duke for first place in ACC
item.description: Clemson overwhelms Cal in Berkeley while notching its 14th consecutive ACC road victory, tied for the second-longest road win streak in conference history.
